# Glass-Box

> Python instruments for model activations and fixed, auditable studies. Agents
> are primary library users; the same interfaces have human-readable docs.

Distribution: glass-box 0.1.0. Import namespace: lfm3lab. Initial adapter:
LiquidAI/LFM3-1.7B at revision 40ebe0aa6662c9d40389c2f5d565b6a2c6aebacd.
Do not infer compute/publication permission from examples or capabilities.

## Read first

- [Agent guide](docs/agents.md): library workflow, entry points, operation payloads, examples, safety and failures.
- [Complete agent documentation](llms-full.txt): agent guide plus the generated full API in one text file.

## API lookup

- [API reference](docs/api/reference.md): source-derived signatures, fields, constants, methods and documented return contracts.
- [Structured API inventory](docs/api/reference.json): machine-readable interface records and source hashes.
- [Browsable API](docs/api/index.html): human module pages with local symbol search.

## Human explanation and provenance

- [Documentation index](docs/index.html): choose a guide for your task.
- [Library guide](docs/library-guide.md): usage, sessions, intervention semantics and evidence.
- [Visual walkthrough](docs/how-we-investigate-lfm3.html): inspect to fixed study, architecture and scopes.
- [README](README.md): installation and model-free quick start.
- [Provenance](docs/provenance.md): library license, decoder attribution and separate model terms.

After wheel installation, use importlib.resources.files("lfm3lab").joinpath("docs")
to read agents.md, library-guide.md, api/reference.md, api/reference.json and
llms-full.txt. The library performs no model import or inference to read docs.
